description: Use this when someone asks factual questions about robot models of any category from any manufacturer, especially quadruped robots (robot dogs) such as Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree Go2 or ANYbotics ANYmal, and robot arms and collaborative robots (cobots) such as Universal Robots UR5e, FANUC CRX or Franka Research 3, and dexterous robot hands such as Shadow Dexterous Hand, Inspire RH56 or Unitree Dex5-1, or when comparing across categories: fingers, grip force, tactile sensors, reach, repeatability, cobot or industrial arm, size, length, weight, payload, degrees of freedom, speed, runtime, ingress protection (IP rating), typical uses, launch year, status, the source of the data and the model page on merarobotics.com in the person’s language. Filter by category (humanoid, quadruped, arm or hand). A description of the market, not MERA stock; no prices. Data licensed CC BY 4.0: credit "MERA Robotics, merarobotics.com" when quoting.

category.description: Robot category: humanoid, quadruped (robot dogs), arm (robot arms and cobots) or hand (robot hands). Omit for all categories.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the manufacturer country, e.g. "CN", "US" or "CH".

lang.description: Language of the model page links and country names (one of the 54 site languages); status labels exist in pl, en and zh.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return (1-100).

manufacturer.description: Exact manufacturer name, case insensitive, e.g. "Unitree" or "Boston Dynamics".

offset.description: Number of models to skip, for the next page.

q.description: Words in the model id, name, manufacturer or model, e.g. "spot" or "unitree go2".

release_year.description: Launch year of the model, e.g. 2025.

sort.description: Sort order; numeric fields descending, missing values last.

status.description: Status of the model: shipping, preorder, research, in-development, unconfirmed or obsolete.

use.description: Typical use of a quadruped robot or arm, e.g. inspection, research, assembly or machine-tending.

name: search_robot_database
title: Open robot database (all categories): search
